WTPS21 PGTW 141300
MSGID/GENADMIN/JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI//
SUBJ/TROPICAL CYCLONE FORMATION ALERT (INVEST 95P)//
RMKS/
1. FORMATION OF A SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE IS POSSIBLE WITHIN
080 NM EITHER SIDE OF A LINE FROM 8.7S 157.0W TO 9.3S 161.5W
WITHIN THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS. AVAILABLE DATA DOES NOT JUSTIFY
ISSUANCE OF NUMBERED TROPICAL CYCLONE WARNINGS AT THIS TIME.
WINDS IN THE AREA ARE ESTIMATED TO BE 28 TO 33 KNOTS. METSAT
IMAGERY AT 141300Z INDICATES THAT A CIRCULATION CENTER IS LOCATED
NEAR 9.2S 157.1W. THE SYSTEM IS MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD AT 04 KNOTS.
2. REMARKS: THE AREA OF CONVECTION (INVEST 95P) PREVIOUSLY LOCATED NEAR 
9.0S 157.8W IS NOW LOCATED NEAR 9.2S 157.1W, APPROXIMATELY 853 NM EAST-
NORTHEAST OF PAGO PAGO. ANIMATED ENHANCED INFRARED (EIR) SATELLITE 
IMAGERY DEPICTS A CONSOLIDATING LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC) WITH 
PERSISTENT DEEP CONVECTION BUILDING OVER THE CENTER WITH A FORMATIVE 
RAINBAND TO THE NORTHERN FLANK OF THE LLCC. A BULLSEYE 140756Z ASCAT 
METOP-B 25KM PASS SHOWS A SWATH OF 20-25 KNOT WINDS THROUGHOUT THE 
SOUTHERN SEMICIRCLE. ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS A FAVORABLE 
ENVIRONMENT FOR DEVELOPMENT WITH LOW VERTICAL WIND SHEAR (VWS) OF 10-15 
KNOTS, STRONG RADIAL OUTFLOW ALOFT DUE TO A POINT SOURCE DIRECTLY 
OVERHEAD, AND WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES (SST) OF 29-30C. GLOBAL 
DETERMINISTIC AND ENSEMBLE MODELS ARE IN GOOD AGREEMENT 95P WILL FURTHER 
CONSOLIDATE WHILE REMAINING QUASI-STATIONARY OVER THE NEXT 12 TO 24 HOURS 
BEFORE TRACKING WEST-SOUTHWESTWARD THEREAFTER. MAXIMUM SUSTAINED SURFACE 
WINDS ARE ESTIMATED AT 28 TO 33 KNOTS. MINIMUM SEA LEVEL PRESSURE IS 
ESTIMATED TO BE NEAR 998 MB. THE POTENTIAL FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A 
SIGNIFICANT TROPICAL CYCLONE WITHIN THE NEXT 24 HOURS IS HIGH.
3. THIS ALERT WILL BE REISSUED, UPGRADED TO WARNING OR CANCELLED BY 
151300Z.//
NNNN
